title: US supreme court to hear arguments in Catholic preschools’ LGBTQ+ exclusion case
summary_full: A decision could reshape the relationship between religious freedom and nondiscrimination laws in the USThe US supreme court will hear arguments on Tuesday over a challenge brought by two Catholic preschools in Colorado, arguing that they should be admitted to the state’s free education system despite their rejection of children with LGBTQ+ parents.A decision in the case, St Mary Catholic Parish v Roy, could reshape the relationship between religious freedom and nondiscrimination laws in the US.
